Víctor Martínez ("V-Mart") is a retired Venezuelan MLB catcher and designated hitter known for his switch-hitting power and consistent batting with the Indians, Red Sox, and Tigers (2002–2018). A 5-time All-Star, he finished his career with a .295 average and was a key part of Detroit's lineup. Key Career Highlights and Details Teams: Cleveland Indians (2002–2009), Boston Red Sox (2009–2010), Detroit Tigers (2011–2018). Victor Martinez Contract/Salary: In 2014, he signed a four-year, $68 million contract extension with the Detroit Tigers, cementing his role as a premier designated hitter. Victor Martinez Home Runs: He finished his 16-year career with 246 home runs and 1,178 RBI. Achievements: Two-time Silver Slugger Award winner and a 5-time All-Star. Playing Style: Recognized as one of the most reliable switch-hitters of his era, often producing high batting averages and low strikeout totals. Retirement: Retired after the 2018 season. Notes Note: This information refers to the Major League Baseball player. It is not related to the pro bodybuilder of the same name.
